description:
Rockstar’s GTA 6 PC release could become the next “Can it run Crysis?” moment. We break down expected system requirements, GPU demands, ray tracing performance, VRAM concerns, and whether your current gaming PC is actually ready for Vice City at max settings. Before you upgrade your GPU or build a new PC for GTA 6, watch this first.
